_readme: Per-place booking channels. This file is the single place to edit when a
venue publishes a real ticketing link. Anything absent here is reported as
未收录 rather than guessed -- a wrong appid or a made-up link is worse than
no link, because it fails silently for the user.
miniprogram.appid / miniprogram.urlLink -- WeChat does NOT let a third
party mint a URL Scheme or URL Link for somebody else's mini program; only
the mini program's own AppSecret can do that. So these two fields can only
be filled with a link the venue itself published (often obtainable from the
mini program's own share menu, or handed over by the merchant).
appid   -> renders <wx-open-launch-weapp> and opens the mini program
in-app. Needs CONFIG.wxAppId (a verified 服务号) set in
web/config.js and the page served inside WeChat.
urlLink -> a https://wxaurl.cn/... link, works in any browser.
site -- the venue's own booking page, if it has one.
note -- shown verbatim under the channel row.
